svg.title: One recorded run next to two simulated ones
svg.desc: Eleven statistics of second-to-second texture, each drawn as the Runsketch value as a share of the same statistic on a real Garmin fēnix 2 run, for a flat 10 km at 5:00/km and 10 km of city blocks at 4:50/km. Speed: 1 s change SD 0.048 on the file against 0.047 flat and 0.054 on city blocks, spread around a 61 s average 4.42 against 4.09 and 4.17 per cent, correlation with the previous second 0.948 against 0.941 and 0.930. GPS: step SD 0.92 against 0.83 and 0.88 m, step correlation 0.728 against 0.626 and 0.639. Chest strap: 1 s change SD 0.61 against 0.61 and 0.59 bpm, seconds unchanged 63.8 against 64.3 and 66.4 per cent, spread around a 61 s average 1.50 against 1.99 and 1.55 bpm and around 121 s 2.44 against 3.24 and 2.49 bpm, the flat route a third above the file on both. Whole strides per minute unchanged 80.9 against 77.8 and 75.3 per cent; skipped seconds 0.71 against 0.62 and 0.59 per cent of intervals. Altitude steps unchanged, 0.2 m and 0.4 m or more: 48, 45 and 7 per cent on the file, 53, 44 and 3 flat, 47, 47 and 6 on city blocks.
